The Southeastern Conference is a collegiate athletic conference whose member institutions are located primarily in the South Central and Southeastern United States. Its 16 members include the flagship public universities of 12 states, 3 additional public land-grant universities, and 1 private research university. The conference is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The SEC participates in the National Collegiate Athletic Association Division I in sports competitions. In football, it is part of the Football Bowl Subdivision, formerly known as Division I-A. WikipediaFounded
